title: nemik run row (W556)
description: One row of a run log: apply-set-runs, reaper-runs, apply-ledger, tier-rehearsal or drum decisions. Out of scope by name: nudges.json (a state map), the fence TSV (measurements) and the paths-forward text ledger. Fields follow PROV-O where they fit: ts is prov:startedAtTime, trigger is prov:wasInformedBy.

ts.description: RFC 3339 instant the run started (prov:startedAtTime). Never absent and never inherited from the previous line.

run_id.description: Names the run; rows of one run share it.

trigger.description: What started the run (prov:wasInformedBy): a timer, a path, a card as <repo>:W<n>, or an operator.

exit.description: The process exit code, always spelled exit (not apply_exit, rc or ok).

verdict.description: The run's verdict as an object, never a JSON string inside the row. Its state axis is separate from the change-lifecycle step (nemik:ChangeLifecycle).

detail.description: Free text for a reader; the lifecycle-word check (nemik:W555) reads it.

inputs_digest.description: sha256 of the inputs the run read, so an unchanged input is visible.
